decisions.object: flutter-noload-38/57/58/96: Flutter libandroid eb90a640 vs U15 9b824502, four added dlopen sites (gl_log -> liboh_android_runtime.so, ensure_driver -> libGLESv2.so, -> libGLESv3.so, eglGetProcAddress -> libEGL.so)
decisions.decision: approve exactly these four N1 rows and the four-added / zero-removed / zero-namespace-delta static allowance
decisions.basis: outer disassembled eb90a640: all four call sites load w1=#0x6 (RTLD_NOW|RTLD_NOLOAD) before bl dlopen@plt at 0x4cf0 / 0x4984 / 0x49a4 / 0x4ad8; NOLOAD only returns an already-loaded image, so no new copy can be created; targets are libraries the process has already loaded
decisions.scope: only these opens; not GL no-op correctness, rendering or lighting; the pre-existing NOW-only libEGL open in flutter_egl.cpp is not re-approved here

decisions.object: runtime-line-1/2: runtime 94c31177 -> 1d42dbfb, two dlopen findings whose PC/source line moved (resolve_oh_wm_funcs 0x19812c->0x198140; eglCreateWindowSurface 0x197a28->0x197ad0)
decisions.basis: packet evidence: target, flags and source statement identical; only the PC and line moved because the M1 split removed surrounding helpers
decisions.scope: exact line-only transfer to the selected partial manifest/inputs; any other field change must come back to the outer

decisions.object: runtime-call-bbq / -sc / -get-window: three call-set diffs from the t4 M1 split
decisions.decision: approve the actual non-zero three-function call-set delta
decisions.basis: outer disassembled 1d42dbfb: android::m1_native_window_from_other_copies(void*(*)(int), int) is the only function calling dl_iterate_phdr + HiLogPrint, and its callers are exactly sc_to_oh_native_window, oh_wm_get_native_window and BBQ_nativeUpdate -- the calls moved into the split entry, none disappeared
decisions.scope: not callsets-0 and not instruction equivalence; watch for FZ-009: the split entry is called through the PLT (exported, preemptible), so with two runtime copies mapped both copies bind to whichever copy the loader finds first -- the FZ-009 re-verify must show that is intended (the function takes the resolved fn pointer explicitly)

decisions.object: 8 ADDED readonly strings in Flutter eb90a640 vs U15 9b824502 (FLUTTER-GLSTUB, eglGetProcAddress, glClearDepth, glClearDepthf, glDepthRange, glDepthRangef, libGLESv2.so, libGLESv3.so); 0 dropped; runtime strings 0/0
decisions.basis: each string is the log tag, the proc name matched by the A2/A3 shims, or the NOLOAD target of the four approved opens

apply_when: outer applies to knowledge/gates only when no board is LOCKed (61b is locked and offline with a pending rollback whose executor checks policy binding)
not_approved_here: Live owner visibility, GL no-op correctness, rendering/lighting, FZ-009 registration, gate application, image baking, window or promotion authority
